description: Gemma 2 is Google's second-generation open-weights model family, available in 2B, 9B, and 27B parameter sizes. It offers state-of-the-art performance for its size class with efficient inference on consumer hardware.

architecture.type: Dense Transformer with sliding window and global attention
features: RMSNorm for pre and post attention normalization

trainingData.description: Trained on 8 trillion tokens (2B), 8 trillion tokens (9B), and 13 trillion tokens (27B) of primarily English web documents, code, and mathematics data.

trainingProcedure: Knowledge distillation from larger models, instruction tuning for -it variants.

evaluation.performanceSummary: State-of-the-art performance in its size class. Gemma 2 27B outperforms Llama 3 70B on several benchmarks while being much smaller.

knownLimitations: May generate incorrect or misleading information
Requires careful prompting for best results

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: Evaluated for bias with mitigation applied during training.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: Safety tuning applied to instruction-tuned variants.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: Open weights allow local deployment for privacy-sensitive applications.

access.license: Gemma Terms of Use (permissive, allows commercial use)

requirements.deployment: Local deployment, cloud deployment via Vertex AI, or through inference providers

hardware.2B: Can run on CPU, ~4GB RAM minimum
hardware.9B: GPU recommended, ~16GB VRAM for full precision
hardware.27B: High-end GPU required, ~48GB VRAM for full precision
